newsitem.title: UK: UK executive pay rises 5.1 pct in H2 1996 - report.
newsitem.headline: UK executive pay rises 5.1 pct in H2 1996 - report.

text.p: Executive pay rose by an average 5.1 percent in the second half of 1996, consultants Sedgwick Noble Lowndes said on Monday, well above average pay increases across the economy of around 4.0 percent.
Medium-sized companies were even more generous with boardroom bosses getting increases of 8.3 percent in the fourth quarter of the year.
"In the past it has been the large companies that have given the highest pay increases to their executives," said Andy Christie, director at Sedgwick Noble Lowndes.
"What we appear to be seeing is a degree of catching up in the middle market - possibly combined with an upturn in company performance to justify the increases."
